view.scene_description: A modern, brightly lit interior space with large windows on the left allowing natural light. People sit at tables working. A prominent curved red wall dominates the right side. Bookshelves spiral upward in the background. The floor is polished and reflective.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Tall, rectangular glass panes span the left wall, letting in bright daylight. They frame an outdoor view of trees and structures. Vertical metal frames divide the panes. Light glare obscures details outside.

objects.label: curved red wall
objects.observation: A smooth, glossy red wall curves from the bottom right toward the center. It occupies the foreground and midground on the right. Its surface reflects ambient light. No visible supports or attachments.

objects.label: people sitting
objects.observation: Several individuals are seated at round tables near the windows. One person wears dark clothing and sits facing away. Another person is partially visible beside them. Both appear to be working on laptops or reading.

objects.label: round tables
objects.observation: Circular tables with metallic or dark tops are placed throughout the room. Some have chairs around them. One table is near the center-left, occupied by people. Others are empty or partially obscured.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical bookshelf with multiple circular shelves spirals upward in the background. Books are arranged on its shelves. It is positioned behind the seated people and near the red wall.

objects.label: chairs
objects.observation: Various chairs are scattered around the tables. Some are transparent plastic with blue seats. Others are darker and less distinct. They are positioned for seating and are mostly unoccupied except for those near the people.

objects.label: laptops
objects.observation: At least two laptops are visible on tables. One is open and being used by a person. Another is closed or partially visible. They are placed on table surfaces and are oriented toward users.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000001", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
